messages:
tess.docs: heads up  i opened a PR to correct streaming examples and OpenAPI for the /v1/generate SSE path. current docs have two issues: the curl example doesn't set Accept: text/event-stream and the OpenAPI response content-type is still application/json which breaks client generators. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1620

marco.eng: ouch. that explains why a few customers reported parsing errors in our example code. can you paste the broken vs intended curl + a minimal SSE snippet?

tess.docs: broken curl (live site):
```bash
curl -N -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model_id":"redwood/gpt-3x","inputs":["Summarize..."],"stream":true}'
```
fixed curl (adds Accept header & stream param clarified):
```bash
curl -N -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: text/event-stream' \
  -d '{"model_id":"redwood/gpt-3x","inputs":["Summarize..."],"stream":true}'
```
minimal SSE client example we want in docs:
```text
event: token
data: {"delta":"The quick brown"}
\n
event: token
data: {"delta":" fox jumps"}
\n
event: done
data: {"id":"req_123"}
```

rita.sdk: noted. our JS SDK streaming helper expects events with `delta` chunks (not `text`) and the OpenAPI should declare `text/event-stream` as the response media type for the streaming operation. i'll update the JS snippet in sdk PR 902 to show `client.generateStream(...)` usage and a parser example that handles `event: token` / `data: JSON` frames.

jordan.prod: can we add a short compatibility note: "Non-streaming responses remain application/json; streaming responses use text/event-stream and send `token`/`done` events with `delta` fields. If you previously parsed `text` fields, switch to `delta`." we should put this in the endpoint top blurb and the migration section.

marco.eng: i ran the fixed curl against staging  stream works and events use `delta`. sample lines appended to the PR description. i also confirmed the server emits `event: token` frames followed by `event: done`.

ci-bot: docs/link-check: failed in docs/pull/1620 \u2014 broken anchor to /sdk/js#streaming-examples.

rita.sdk: i'll open sdk PR 903 to fix the readme anchor and land SDK snippet changes alongside the docs PR. sdk will keep a tiny compat shim that maps `delta` -> `text` for older clients for the next two releases.

tess.docs: i'll update the OpenAPI example to use:
```yaml
content:
  text/event-stream:
    schema: { type: string }
```
and add an explanatory note plus the SSE sample above. also swapping previous response examples that showed `text` to `delta`-based ones.

jordan.prod: added to release notes under "API reference fixes: streaming content-type and SSE examples" and will notify CS to include a snippet for customers using server-sent-event parsers. :thumbsup:

marco.eng: once link-check and the SDK anchor fix are green, i'm good to merge after one more quick smoke test. ping me here.

tess.docs: tracking: docs PR 1620 (SSE + OpenAPI content-type + examples), sdk PRs 902/903 (snippet + anchor), release note entry. thanks all.
